# Helvety OCR

> Extract text from PDFs and images in your browser on your device. Scanned or photographed pages run through on-device OCR, and born-digital PDFs reuse their existing text layer. Read, copy, or download plain text. No file upload to Helvety servers in the normal flow. Engineered, designed and made in Switzerland.

## Canonical URL
- [Helvety OCR](https://helvety.com/ocr): Main application route

## Crawling And Indexing
- The public OCR route is intended to be crawlable and indexable.

## Related Helvety Apps
- [Helvety](https://helvety.com)
- [Helvety Store](https://helvety.com/store/products)
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/pdf)
- [Helvety Image Editor](https://helvety.com/image-editor)

## Licensing
The helvety.com monorepo is released under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Separately distributed Helvety product repositories may use different open-source licenses, including MIT, so always check the LICENSE file in the specific repository or release source link.

## Source
- [GitHub - helvety.com monorepo](https://github.com/CasparRubin/helvety): Web applications and shared packages (AGPL-3.0)

## Third-party libraries
- [Tesseract.js](https://tesseract.projectnaptha.com/) (Apache-2.0) powers on-device OCR.
- [pdf.js](https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/) (Apache-2.0), via react-pdf (MIT), renders and reads PDF pages.
